editorial.blurb: Masala Pizza Company blends Indian spices with pizza creativity, offering loaded fries and fusion pies that draw loyal regulars—though recent quality concerns have shaken its reputation.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the loaded fries with paneer and extra moti and mint sauce if you want the dish reviewers have been ordering monthly for years; top it yourself with yogurt or sour cream for the best results, and note that quality has recently become inconsistent.
signatureDishes: Loaded fries with paneer and moti and mint sauce

topDishes.dish: Loaded fries with paneer and moti and mint sauce
topDishes.note: A beloved years-long favorite that travels well and layers fries beneath a loaded hot mess
Seasoned to perfection, comes hot and fresh with vegetarian-friendly execution
Praised alongside the Masala Elote variant for great flavor
